mapper.select: SELECT a.kwlg_id, a.kwlg_tit, a.kwlg_func_tp_cd, a.kwlg_diet_tp_cd, COALESCE(a.kwlg_view_qty, 0) AS kwlg_view_qty, a.kwlg_link_url, a.kwlg_atch_url, a.kwlg_aut, a.cre_usr_id, a.cre_dt, a.upd_usr_id, a.upd_dt, count(*) over() AS ttl_no, b.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS kwlg_func_tp_nm, c.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS kwlg_diet_tp_nm, 1 as no FROM kwlg_mgmt a LEFT JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl b ON ( b.intg_cd = 'CD00008' AND a.kwlg_func_tp_cd = b.intg_cd_val_ctnt ) LEFT JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl c ON ( c.intg_cd = 'CD00011' AND a.kwlg_diet_tp_cd = c.intg_cd_val_ctnt ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.kwlg_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kwlg_mgmt ( kwlg_tit, kwlg_func_tp_cd, kwlg_diet_tp_cd, kwlg_view_qty, kwlg_link_url, kwlg_atch_url, kwlg_aut, cre_usr_id, cre_dt, upd_usr_id, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{kwlgTit}, #{kwlgFuncTpCd}, #{kwlgDietTpCd}, 0, #{kwlgLinkUrl}, (#{kwlgAtchUrl} || (SELECT currval('kwlg_mgmt_kwlg_id_seq'))), #{kwlgAut}, #{creUsrId}, #{creDt}, #{updUsrId}, #{updDt} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE kwlg_mgmt
kwlg_tit = #{kwlgTit},
kwlg_func_tp_cd = #{kwlgFuncTpCd},
kwlg_diet_tp_cd = #{kwlgDietTpCd},
kwlg_view_qty = #{kwlgViewQtt},
kwlg_link_url = #{kwlgLinkUrl},
kwlg_atch_url = #{kwlgAtchUrl},
kwlg_aut = #{kwlgAut},
upd_usr_id = #{updUsrId},
upd_dt = #{updDt},
WHERE kwlg_id = #{kwlgId}
